code_block:
- block:
        - name: Ensure firewalld is installed
          ansible.builtin.package:
            name: firewalld
            state: present

        - name: Ensure firewalld service is enabled and running
          ansible.builtin.service:
            name: firewalld
            state: started
            enabled: true

        - name: Get default firewalld zone
          ansible.builtin.command: firewall-cmd --get-default-zone
          register: fw_default_zone
          changed_when: false

        - name: Allow required services (SSH, HTTPS) in default zone (permanent and runtime)
          ansible.posix.firewalld:
            service: "{{ item }}"
            zone: "{{ fw_default_zone.stdout | trim }}"
            state: enabled
            permanent: true
            immediate: true
          loop: "{{ allowed_services_firewalld }}"

        - name: List existing services in default zone (permanent)
          ansible.builtin.command: "firewall-cmd --permanent --zone={{ fw_default_zone.stdout | trim }} --list-services"
          register: fw_services
          changed_when: false

        - name: Disable non-allowed services in default zone
          ansible.posix.firewalld:
            service: "{{ item }}"
            zone: "{{ fw_default_zone.stdout | trim }}"
            state: disabled
            permanent: true
            immediate: true
          loop: "{{ (fw_services.stdout | default('') | trim) | split() }}"
          when: item not in allowed_services_firewalld

        - name: List existing open ports in default zone (permanent)
          ansible.builtin.command: "firewall-cmd --permanent --zone={{ fw_default_zone.stdout | trim }} --list-ports"
          register: fw_ports
          changed_when: false

        - name: Disable non-allowed TCP ports in default zone
          ansible.posix.firewalld:
            port: "{{ item }}"
            zone: "{{ fw_default_zone.stdout | trim }}"
            state: disabled
            permanent: true
            immediate: true
          loop: "{{ (fw_ports.stdout | default('') | trim) | split() }}"
          when:
            - item != ''
            - item is match('^[0-9]+/tcp$')
            - (item.split('/')[0]) not in allowed_ports_tcp

        - name: Set default zone target to DROP (deny all other inbound)
          ansible.posix.firewalld:
            zone: "{{ fw_default_zone.stdout | trim }}"
            target: DROP
            permanent: true
            immediate: true
      when: use_firewalld

    - block:
        - name: Ensure ufw is installed

failed_checks.check_name: Ensure block is handling task errors properly
code_block:
- block:
        - name: Ensure ufw is installed
          ansible.builtin.package:
            name: ufw
            state: present

        - name: Get UFW status (verbose)
          ansible.builtin.command: ufw status verbose
          register: ufw_status
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false

        - name: Determine if extraneous allow rules exist
          ansible.builtin.set_fact:
            ufw_allowed_targets_raw: "{{ ufw_status.stdout | default('') | regex_findall('^\\s*([0-9A-Za-z_./() :+-]+?)\\s+ALLOW', multiline=True) | map('regex_replace', ' \\(v6\\)', '') | map('trim') | list }}"
            ufw_allowed_expected_labels:
              - "22/tcp"
              - "443/tcp"
              - "OpenSSH"
        - name: Normalize allowed rules and compute extraneous
          ansible.builtin.set_fact:
            ufw_extraneous_allows: >-
              {{
                ufw_allowed_targets_raw
                | reject('in', ufw_allowed_expected_labels)
                | list
              }}

        - name: Reset UFW if extraneous allows are present
          ansible.builtin.command: ufw --force reset
          when: ufw_extraneous_allows | length > 0
          changed_when: true

        - name: Ensure default incoming policy is deny
          community.general.ufw:
            direction: incoming
            policy: deny

        - name: Ensure default outgoing policy is allow
          community.general.ufw:
            direction: outgoing
            policy: allow

        - name: Allow SSH (22/tcp)
          community.general.ufw:
            rule: allow
            port: "22"
            proto: tcp

        - name: Allow HTTPS (443/tcp)
          community.general.ufw:
            rule: allow
            port: "443"
            proto: tcp

        - name: Ensure UFW is enabled
          community.general.ufw:
            state: enabled
            logging: 'on'
      when:
        - not use_firewalld
        - use_ufw
